message.content:
I’m sorry to hear about the inconvenience caused by the sudden cancellation.  
Unfortunately, the internal ticket‑management system is currently unavailable, so I’m unable to submit a formal support ticket on your behalf at this moment.

**What you can do next**

| Option | How to proceed |
|--------|----------------|
| **Email** | Send a detailed message to support@yourcompany.com with the subject “航班取消經驗” and include the text: “突然的取消造成了重大不便，打亂了我的旅行計劃並造成了經濟損失。” |
| **Phone** | Call our 24/7 support line at +1‑800‑555‑1234. Have your user ID (cmartinez) and the booking reference handy. |
| **Live Chat** | Visit the support portal (https://support.yourcompany.com) and start a chat session. |
| **Social Media** | Reach out via our official Twitter handle @YourCompanySupport – we monitor messages daily. |

If you’d like me to keep track of this issue or follow up once the ticketing system is back online, just let me know. I’ll do my best to ensure your concerns are addressed promptly.

Let's do that.
